mechanism: The sealed Pair 1 authority uses AB-CHARACTER-0001. The Planning event topology adapter rejects any expected identity not matching EV-[0-9A-F]{8}; validate_event_realization_artifact catches that compiler ValueError and reports SLICE1_EVENT_REALIZATION_INVALID at /narrative, then the launcher reduces the receipt to slice1_generated_candidate_rejected.
secondary_causes: CAMPAIGN_CASE_DESIGN_DEFECT: fixture generator created an identity outside the downstream contract
LOCAL_VALIDATOR_DIAGNOSTIC_OVERBROADNESS: compiler identity errors are attributed to /narrative
OBSERVABILITY_GAP: launcher did not persist the validation receipt, although closed-world reconstruction still identifies this root cause
reason_sample_invalid: The control arm never reached the campaign's required valid frozen artifact state because the shared fixture is incompatible with the validator/compiler contract.
